claim: The sample demo stays separate from real records and remains readable after creation.
where: landing action note, demo banner, README, privacy
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo; verify no owner keys and repeat the post-create read 16 times

claim: A decision produces a timestamped PDF containing the named approver and fixed quote snapshot.
sandbox: fresh record; approve as José Núñez — Direção; extract PDF text and assert identity, timestamp, client, quote, hash, and consent

claim: The sender can export or delete each record.
sandbox: fresh record; export with owner token, delete it, and assert its approval link returns 404

claim: No analytics, advertising, or third-party runtime scripts load.
where: landing privacy section and privacy page
sandbox: capture every browser request through landing and demo and assert all are same-origin

claim: Free records expire after 30 days, demos after 24 hours, and 365 days requires a server-verified Studio license.
sandbox: assert exact API expiry windows and that a direct forged 365-day request returns 403

claim: Approval and owner links use independent random tokens, and private responses are noindex and no-store.
sandbox: create two records; validate distinct token shapes and private route response headers

claim: Each fixed quote accepts one final decision.
sandbox: submit two concurrent decisions and assert one 201 receipt and one 409 conflict

claim: Network addresses are salted before storage and never appear in receipts or sender exports.
sandbox: record a decision with a known forwarded address; unit-test salted hashing and assert the address is absent from receipt and export

claim: API write bursts are rate limited with retry guidance.
sandbox: send a 20-request write burst and assert 429 plus Retry-After

claim: The non-root container starts with only PORT, creates a random privacy salt on first boot, and health reports its build identity.
sandbox: build the release binary; start it from a clean temporary directory with only PORT; assert health and the generated salt, then inspect the image contract

claim: A committed record is restored from the configured durable state directory after a replacement process starts.
sandbox: create a demo with one process and durable directory; start a second process with a different local directory and assert the record is readable
